construction: 583 placements in 68 steps in one section; the source never splits the airframe. Fuselage: red 32525, 32278 and 32524 beams with cross blocks; wings: beams with 64681/64393 panels; nose: a 4716 worm, 3648 24-tooth gear and 32072 knob gears driving the propeller beam; the LS40/LS41/LS50/LS51 LSynth flex-axle segments as the curved leading edges and cables.
interfaces: Studless: 201 up, 137 sideways, 218 angled. The `9394 - Main.ldr` wrapper places the airframe; the flex axles end in connectors at the wing tips; the gear's three wheels sit on pins and axles under the belly.
lesson: A studless Technic propeller plane kept as one section: a red liftarm fuselage and wings with white panel skins, a 15-long beam as the two-blade propeller on a worm-and-knob gear train, tricycle gear on 42610 wheels plus a tail wheel, and two LSynth flexible axles arcing wingtip to wingtip as the wing leading edges. Measured: span 54 studs, length 60, height 16, 583 placements, 66% Technic.
parent_context: `9394 - Main.ldr` places it at the origin with the identity matrix; this is the 9394 Jet Plane's B model, built with the propeller at −Z.
reuse_notes: Use it for the layout of a studless Technic trainer: length 1.1× span, low wing, tricycle gear, propeller on a geared nose axle. Inspiration only: the 163 LSynth segments use mirrored matrices, so rebuild the flex leading edges with the flex workflow.
